title: Certain Uses in C2 Districts
previewText: Within the locations shown on Map 2 (Commercial Core) in the Appendix to this Chapter, the use regulations shall be modified within C2 Districts to permit uses listed under Use Groups VI and VIII, pursuant to the regulations for a C4 District.
